description: This file defines the KmsMaterialsProvider class within the Aws\Crypto namespace. It provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data encryption keys (CEK) using AWS KMS, and also handles legacy encryption workflows. It relies on an Aws\Kms\KmsClient instance and manages a KMS key ID. The class implements methods to create a materials provider based on encryption envelopes, get materials description, and perform encryption and decryption of CEKs.

classes.name: Aws\Crypto\KmsMaterialsProvider
classes.description: Provides an implementation for managing encryption materials using AWS KMS, including legacy workflows for encrypting and decrypting data encryption keys, with methods to generate and retrieve encryption material descriptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting an AWS KMS client and an optional KMS Key ID.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Creates a materials provider instance from a decryption envelope containing encryption metadata.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Returns an array describing the KMS key ID used by this provider.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrap algorithm, 'kms'.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Encrypts a Content Encryption Key (CEK) using AWS KMS's Encrypt API.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted CEK using AWS KMS's Decrypt API.
